title: Rewrite TESTING.md for the current workspace layout
description:
TESTING.md still describes the pre-workspace repository: a cli/ crate root, flat module files, dated test counts, property-based testing listed as future work, and a TestHarness API sketch that does not match the actual harness.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: All paths in TESTING.md point at crates/jit/ locations that exist
- [hard] REQ-02: The document contains no dated or hardcoded test counts
- [hard] REQ-03: Property-based testing is described as current practice
- [hard] REQ-04: The TestHarness description matches the actual API in crates/jit/tests/harness.rs (in-memory backing, real method set)
- [hard] REQ-05: Every link in the document resolves
